description: Private-sector service flow (customers served / room-nights / transactions / tickets) emitted by legal-entity DIDs. ADR-0028. PII tier 1 — aggregate counts only, no individual customer DID. ADR-0018 k-anonymity: cohort_size >= 5.

sourceDid.description: Legal-entity facade DID providing the service. Canonical actor vector key is sourceRootDid (ADR-0074).

sourceRootDid.description: ADR-0074 canonical ERC725 root for sourceDid.

counterpartyDid.description: Legal-entity facade DID of customer (B2B). Individual customer DIDs forbidden — use cohortId.

counterpartyRootDid.description: ADR-0074 canonical ERC725 root for counterpartyDid.

serviceClass.description: Domain-specific class (e.g. room_night, flight_segment, ticket, transaction, support_case)

unit.description: Unit for count (e.g. room_nights, pax, orders, sessions)

revenue.description: Optional monetary total associated with this service flow. Use legalEntityCurrencyFlow for canonical revenue.

cohortSize.description: k-anonymity bucket size when cohortId is set (ADR-0018). MUST be >= 5.
